scenario:
A renewable energy company is developing a comprehensive Wind Energy Prediction Platform to enhance the efficiency and reliability of wind energy production. This enterprise-level platform is designed to predict wind energy output using advanced machine learning models. The platform will cater to various user types, such as administrators, data scientists, and end-users, enabling them to manage datasets, preprocess data, build models, and deploy them for real-time predictions.

The platform requires a robust system to handle the lifecycle of machine learning models, from data gathering and cleaning to model training and deployment. It will incorporate a web application interface for seamless interaction with the prediction models hosted on cloud infrastructure. Users will be able to perform data preprocessing to optimize datasets, apply linear regression algorithms for model training, and deploy models using IBM Cloud services. The integration of Flask for web application development ensures a user-friendly interface for accessing and utilizing prediction models.

The system will feature task management capabilities to track user stories, acceptance criteria, and priorities across development sprints. A comprehensive release management module will ensure that features are delivered on time and meet quality standards. The platform's architecture will support scalability and reliability, providing insights that drive better decision-making in wind energy production.
